story.fullStory:
Def Leppard's "Rock Of Ages" reached #16 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Rock of Ages" is a song by Def Leppard from their 1983 album Pyromania.

When issued as a single in the United States, the song reached #16 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart and #19 on the Cash Box Top 100.

It also hit #1 on the Top Tracks Rock chart.

The song peaked at #16 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 15 weeks on the chart.

approvedFacts.text: "Rock of Ages" is a song by Def Leppard from their 1983 album Pyromania.
When issued as a single in the United States, the song reached #16 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart and #19 on the Cash Box Top 100.
It also hit #1 on the Top Tracks Rock chart.
The song peaked at #16 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 15 weeks on the chart.
Pyromania is the third studio album by English rock band Def Leppard, released on 20 January 1983 through Vertigo Records in Europe and through Mercury Records in the US.
The first album to feature guitarist Phil Collen who replaced founding member Pete Willis, Pyromania was produced by Robert John "Mutt" Lange.
The album was a shift away from the band's traditional heavy metal roots toward a more radio-friendly sound, finding massive mainstream success.
